newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers steady, Med firms slightly.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers steady, Med firms slightly.

text.p: ARA bunkers barely changed on Monday after barges lost their morning gains, while prices in southern Europe were steady to $1 firmer, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were again quoted at $87/$88 fob, after barges retreated from a high of $87 ex wharf in the morning.
Total ARA volume reached about 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were also broadly stable with a reasonable level of enquiries in the morning.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers rose $1 a tonne in certain ports, although some suppliers, keen to shift material after last week's holidays, offered at unchanged levels.
"(Prices) really should have gone up, but competition does not allow it," one Mediterranean supplier said.
Egyptian prices were steady. Supplies in all ports was adequate.
